property_summary: For any depositor and any contract funding, a single withdrawAll call pays the depositor exactly their credited amount (re-entry during the external call must be a no-op because credit is zeroed before the call); the mutant leaves credit set during the call, so a re-entrant attacker gets paid twice, violating the exact-payout rule.
change_summary: Delete the statement that resets the sender's credit to zero before the external call.
